    def _drain_queue(self) -> "_Tick":
        """Drain everything queued so far into one tick.  Control sentinels stop the drain
        (they take effect this tick); _FINAL_TEXT / _TOOL_PROGRESS / text deltas fold into
        state so simultaneous items batch."""
        tick = _Tick()
        while True:
            try:
                item = self._queue.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                return tick
            if item is _DONE:
                tick.got_done = True
                return tick
            if item is _NEW_SEGMENT:
                tick.got_segment_break = True
                return tick
            if item is _REOPEN_SEED:
                tick.got_reopen_seed = True
                return tick
            kind = item[0] if isinstance(item, tuple) and item else None
            if kind is _FINAL_TEXT:
                self._adopt_final_text(item[1])
            elif kind is _TOOL_PROGRESS:  # keep draining to batch simultaneous lines
                if self._use_native_streaming:
                    self._tool_progress_lines.append(item[1])
                    self._tool_progress_active = True
            elif kind is _APPROVAL_BOUNDARY:
                tick.approval_boundary = (item[1], item[2])
                return tick
            elif kind is _COMMENTARY:
                tick.commentary_text = item[1]
                return tick
            elif kind is _FLUSH:
                # Barrier: finalize like a tool boundary, signal at the end of the tick.
                tick.got_flush = tick.got_segment_break = True
                tick.flush_event = item[1]
                return tick
            else:
                self._filter_and_accumulate(item)

    def _adopt_final_text(self, final_raw: str) -> None:
        """Adopt the authoritative final (see finish()) as the finalize content — only if this
        consumer streamed something (a no-stream turn keeps the gateway's final-send
        ownership).  Split delivery: wholesale adoption would repeat sealed heads, refusing
        makes the gateway resend the ENTIRE body — so append only the suffix when the final
        strictly prefix-extends the ledger."""
        if not (self._accumulated or self._message_id or self._last_sent_text):
            return
        if not self._turn_split_delivery:
            final_payload = self._clean_for_display(final_raw)
            if final_payload and final_payload != self._clean_for_display(self._accumulated):
                self._accumulated = final_raw
                self._stream_ledger = final_raw
            return
        ledger = self._stream_ledger
        if ledger and final_raw.startswith(ledger) and len(final_raw) > len(ledger):
            self._accumulated += final_raw[len(ledger):]
            self._stream_ledger = final_raw

    async def _eager_reopen_seed(self) -> None:
        """Eager re-seed after a clarify answer (gate re-checked: state may have advanced).
        Trade-off: WeCom's ~6-minute stream limit (errcode 846608, from the FIRST frame)
        now starts at the reply instant; on expiry we degrade to send()."""
        if not self._reopen_seed_pending():
            return
        if await self._try_seed_frame("Eager reopen seed raised, disabling native: %s"):

            self._native_last_pushed_len = 0

                        "(typing bubble reopened immediately, turn=%s)", self._turn_id)

        """Decide whether this tick flushes an edit/frame."""
        if not tick.is_interim:
            return True
        if self.cfg.buffer_only:
            return False
        if self._use_native_streaming:
            # No platform edit-rate limit: push every delta immediately.
            should_edit = bool(self._accumulated) or self._tool_progress_active
        else:
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_edit_time
            # buffer_threshold is a codepoint debounce heuristic, not a
            # platform-limit check (_len_fn is for overflow).  It must not
            # override an active flood backoff: while a refusal is being
            # waited out, only the (server-requested) interval may fire an edit.
            should_edit = bool((elapsed >= self._current_edit_interval and self._accumulated)

        # marker ("NO"→"NO_REPLY"); got_done always resolves the buffer.

    async def _split_first_send(self, tick: "_Tick") -> bool:
        """No message to edit yet and the buffer overflows: seal only the head chunks; the
        tail stays in _accumulated as the active preview later deltas edit in place.
        True when the turn finished here (the run loop returns)."""
        chunks = self._truncate_for_stream(self._accumulated, self._safe_limit, self._len_fn)
        if len(chunks) <= 1:
            # Malformed/legacy adapter result must still be splittable.
            chunks = self._split_text_chunks(self._accumulated, self._safe_limit, self._len_fn)
        reply_to = self._initial_reply_to_id
        heads_delivered = len(chunks) > 1
        for chunk in chunks[:-1]:
            new_id = await self._send_new_chunk(chunk, reply_to, final=tick.got_done)
            if new_id is None or new_id == reply_to:
                heads_delivered = False  # keep the full text intact for the gateway fallback
                break
            reply_to = new_id

        if heads_delivered:
            # truncate_message suffixes multi-chunk output with " (n/n)"; the tail is the LIVE
            # preview later deltas extend, so a kept indicator ends up embedded mid-reply.
            tail = chunks[-1]
            indicator = f" ({len(chunks)}/{len(chunks)})"
            self._accumulated = tail[: -len(indicator)] if tail.endswith(indicator) else tail
            # Flag BEFORE the tail send: fresh-final replaces every tracked preview
            # with one message, which is only valid while the active message holds
            # the whole answer — deleting sealed heads drops delivered text.
            self._turn_split_delivery = True
        # Heads are sealed (or a later head failed): never edit a sealed message with
        # the unsplit payload — the tail is sent fresh, or the fallback path retries.
        self._message_id = None
        self._message_created_ts = None
        self._last_sent_text = ""
        self._last_edit_time = time.monotonic()

                              or await self._send_or_edit(self._accumulated, finalize=True))
            # ``_already_sent`` may be True from prior state — only heads + tail count.
            self._final_response_sent = heads_delivered and tail_delivered
            if self._final_response_sent:
                self._turn_split_delivery = True
                self._mark_final_delivered(record=self._accumulated)
            return True
        if tick.got_segment_break:
            self._fallback_final_send = False
            self._fallback_prefix = ""
        return False

    def _overflows(self) -> bool:
        return self._len_fn(self._accumulated) > self._safe_limit

    def _first_send_overflows(self) -> bool:
        return self._message_id is None and self._overflows()

    async def _seal_overflow_heads(self) -> None:
        """Existing message overflowing: seal it with the head, start a new message for the rest."""
        while self._overflows() and self._message_id is not None and self._edit_supported:
            cp_budget = _custom_unit_to_cp(self._accumulated, self._safe_limit, self._len_fn)
            split_at = self._accumulated.rfind("\n", 0, cp_budget)
            if split_at < cp_budget // 2:

                break  # keep the full text intact for the fallback final send
            self._accumulated = self._accumulated[split_at:].lstrip("\n")
            self._message_id = None
            self._last_sent_text = ""

        the legacy attribute; both on the CLASS (MagicMock-safe)."""

        if not callable(probe):
            return getattr(self.adapter, "draft_stream_is_message", False) is True
        try:

        editable previews on Telegram's legacy send path."""
        meta = dict(self.metadata) if self.metadata else {}

        """Record what the user actually saw as this turn's final answer.  On a split ``text``

        the gateway sees a mismatch and re-sends an answer the user already received."""

        """Drain everything queued so far into one tick.  Control sentinels stop the drain
        (they take effect this tick); _FINAL_TEXT / _TOOL_PROGRESS / text deltas fold into
        state so simultaneous items batch."""
        tick = _Tick()
        while True:
            try:
                item = self._queue.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                return tick
            if item is _DONE:
                tick.got_done = True
                return tick
            if item is _NEW_SEGMENT:
                tick.got_segment_break = True

            if item is _REOPEN_SEED:

            kind = item[0] if isinstance(item, tuple) and item else None
            if kind is _FINAL_TEXT:
                self._adopt_final_text(item[1])
            elif kind is _TOOL_PROGRESS:  # keep draining to batch simultaneous lines
                if self._use_native_streaming:
                    self._tool_progress_lines.append(item[1])
                    self._tool_progress_active = True
            elif kind is _APPROVAL_BOUNDARY:
                tick.approval_boundary = (item[1], item[2])
                return tick
            elif kind is _COMMENTARY:
                tick.commentary_text = item[1]
                return tick
            elif kind is _FLUSH:
                # Barrier: finalize like a tool boundary, signal at the end of the tick.
                tick.got_flush = tick.got_segment_break = True

        consumer streamed something (a no-stream turn keeps the gateway's final-send
        ownership).  Split delivery: wholesale adoption would repeat sealed heads, refusing
        makes the gateway resend the ENTIRE body — so append only the suffix when the final
        strictly prefix-extends the ledger."""

            return

            final_payload = self._clean_for_display(final_raw)
            if final_payload and final_payload != self._clean_for_display(self._accumulated):
                self._accumulated = final_raw
                self._stream_ledger = final_raw
            return
        ledger = self._stream_ledger

        now starts at the reply instant; on expiry we degrade to send()."""

            # No platform edit-rate limit: push every delta immediately.

        else:
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_edit_time

            # platform-limit check (_len_fn is for overflow).  It must not
            # override an active flood backoff: while a refusal is being
            # waited out, only the (server-requested) interval may fire an edit.

    async def _split_first_send(self, tick: "_Tick") -> bool:
        """No message to edit yet and the buffer overflows: seal only the head chunks; the
        tail stays in _accumulated as the active preview later deltas edit in place.

        chunks = self._truncate_for_stream(self._accumulated, self._safe_limit, self._len_fn)
        if len(chunks) <= 1:
            # Malformed/legacy adapter result must still be splittable.
            chunks = self._split_text_chunks(self._accumulated, self._safe_limit, self._len_fn)
        reply_to = self._initial_reply_to_id
        heads_delivered = len(chunks) > 1
        for chunk in chunks[:-1]:
            new_id = await self._send_new_chunk(chunk, reply_to, final=tick.got_done)

            # preview later deltas extend, so a kept indicator ends up embedded mid-reply.

            # with one message, which is only valid while the active message holds
            # the whole answer — deleting sealed heads drops delivered text.

        # the unsplit payload — the tail is sent fresh, or the fallback path retries.

        self._message_created_ts = None

                              or await self._send_or_edit(self._accumulated, finalize=True))

            self._final_response_sent = heads_delivered and tail_delivered

                self._mark_final_delivered(record=self._accumulated)
            return True
        if tick.got_segment_break:
            self._fallback_final_send = False
            self._fallback_prefix = ""
        return False

        return self._len_fn(self._accumulated) > self._safe_limit

    def _first_send_overflows(self) -> bool:

    def _drain_queue(self) -> "_Tick":
        """Drain everything queued so far into one tick.  Control sentinels stop the drain
        (they take effect this tick); _FINAL_TEXT / _TOOL_PROGRESS / text deltas fold into
        state so simultaneous items batch."""
        tick = _Tick()
        while True:
            try:
                item = self._queue.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                return tick
            if item is _DONE:
                tick.got_done = True
                return tick
            if item is _NEW_SEGMENT:
                tick.got_segment_break = True
                return tick
            if item is _REOPEN_SEED:
                tick.got_reopen_seed = True
                return tick
            kind = item[0] if isinstance(item, tuple) and item else None
            if kind is _FINAL_TEXT:
                self._adopt_final_text(item[1])
            elif kind is _TOOL_PROGRESS:  # keep draining to batch simultaneous lines
                if self._use_native_streaming:
                    self._tool_progress_lines.append(item[1])
                    self._tool_progress_active = True
            elif kind is _APPROVAL_BOUNDARY:
                tick.approval_boundary = (item[1], item[2])
                return tick
            elif kind is _COMMENTARY:
                tick.commentary_text = item[1]
                return tick
            elif kind is _FLUSH:
                # Barrier: finalize like a tool boundary, signal at the end of the tick.
                tick.got_flush = tick.got_segment_break = True
                tick.flush_event = item[1]
                return tick
            else:
                self._filter_and_accumulate(item)

        consumer streamed something (a no-stream turn keeps the gateway's final-send
        ownership).  Split delivery: wholesale adoption would repeat sealed heads, refusing
        makes the gateway resend the ENTIRE body — so append only the suffix when the final
        strictly prefix-extends the ledger."""
        if not (self._accumulated or self._message_id or self._last_sent_text):
            return
        if not self._turn_split_delivery:
            final_payload = self._clean_for_display(final_raw)
            if final_payload and final_payload != self._clean_for_display(self._accumulated):
                self._accumulated = final_raw
                self._stream_ledger = final_raw
            return
        ledger = self._stream_ledger
        if ledger and final_raw.startswith(ledger) and len(final_raw) > len(ledger):
            self._accumulated += final_raw[len(ledger):]
            self._stream_ledger = final_raw

class SessionSource:
    """Where a message originated: routes responses, feeds the system-prompt
    context block, and records origin for cron delivery."""
    platform: Platform
    chat_id: str
    chat_name: Optional[str] = None
    chat_type: str = "dm"  # "dm", "group", "channel", "thread"
    user_id: Optional[str] = None
    user_name: Optional[str] = None
    thread_id: Optional[str] = None  # forum topics, Discord threads, etc.
    chat_topic: Optional[str] = None  # channel topic/description (Discord, Slack)
    user_id_alt: Optional[str] = None  # platform-specific stable alt ID (Signal UUID, Feishu union_id)
    chat_id_alt: Optional[str] = None  # Signal group internal ID
    is_bot: bool = False  # message author is a bot/webhook (Discord)
    # Platform-neutral SCOPE discriminator (Discord guild / Slack workspace / Matrix server) driving
    # isolation. ``guild_id`` is a deprecated alias: both written, ``scope_id`` wins on read.
    scope_id: Optional[str] = None
    guild_id: Optional[str] = None
    parent_chat_id: Optional[str] = None  # parent channel when chat_id is a thread
    message_id: Optional[str] = None  # triggering message (pin/reply/react)
    role_authorized: bool = False  # adapter granted access via role, not user ID
    # Multiplex profile this message routes to (None => active/default); namespaces the key.

Confirmed the cause: auth tool instructions tell the model to link the card it just posted; Slack then unfurls that card inside the extra reply.

The process-local receipt design is sound. Complete these delivery guards:

1. Block post-card stream deltas and interim replies for the exact inbound event.
2. Finish existing previews without adopting the redundant final text.
3. Skip stale-preview reconciliation and queued first-response delivery when that card owns the reply.
4. Preserve failed, partial, interrupted, invited-owner, later-message, and resume replies.

`SessionSource` serialization excludes the typed receipt, so it cannot survive accidentally or be supplied through incoming Slack data.

"""A delivered private sign-in card owns only its exact Slack turn's reply."""
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

import pytest

from test_clanker_vault import service  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from test_kernel_managed_auth import managed, ORIGIN, remote_result  # noqa: F401
from test_private_link_delivery import delivery  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from gateway.config import Platform, StreamingConfig
from gateway.display_config import resolve_display_setting
from gateway.platforms.event import MessageEvent
from gateway.private_access_response import private_access_response_pending
from gateway.run import GatewayRunner
from gateway.run_turn_runner import TurnRunner
from gateway.session import SessionSource
from gateway.slack_workspace import SlackWorkspaceMembership
from gateway.stream_consumer import StreamConsumerConfig
from gateway.turn_context import TurnContext


def gateway(f):
    # Exercise the production workspace-policy resolver, with only Slack I/O fake.
    membership = object.__new__(SlackWorkspaceMembership)
    membership.vault_service = f.service
    adapter = f.service.policy.adapter
    adapter._workspace_membership = membership
    runner = object.__new__(GatewayRunner)
    runner.adapters = {Platform.SLACK: adapter}
    runner._delivery_adapter_for = MagicMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace())
    runner._should_send_voice_reply = MagicMock(return_value=False)
    runner._send_voice_reply = AsyncMock()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response = AsyncMock()
    return runner


async def final_reply(runner, turn, result=None, *, source=None, event_id=None):
    source = source or turn.source
    event = MessageEvent(turn.message, source=source,
        message_id=event_id or turn.message_id)
    text = "Open the private sign-in message; I'll continue after sign-in."
    value = await runner._hmwa_deliver_turn_response(
        event, source, SimpleNamespace(session_id='auth-task'), 'auth-lane', 1,
        {'completed': True} if result is None else result, [], text, 'footer', False,
    )
    return value, text


def stream_surface(runner, turn, *, streaming):
    adapter = SimpleNamespace(
        SUPPORTS_MESSAGE_EDITING=True, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=4000,
        send=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
        edit_message=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
    )
    runner.config = SimpleNamespace(streaming=StreamingConfig(enabled=streaming, transport='edit'))
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.return_value = adapter
    runner._build_stream_consumer_config = lambda *args, **kwargs: (
        StreamConsumerConfig(edit_interval=.01, buffer_threshold=1, cursor='', transport='edit'), None)
    tts = SimpleNamespace(on_delta=MagicMock())
    ctx = TurnContext(source=turn.source, inbound_message_id=turn.message_id,
        event_message_id=turn.message_id, session_key='auth-lane', user_config={},
        resolve_display_setting=resolve_display_setting, interim_assistant_messages_enabled=True,
        streaming_tts_consumer_holder=[tts], _run_still_current=lambda: True)
    surface = TurnRunner(runner, ctx)
    consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, _ = surface._setup_stream_consumer('slack')
    assert consumer is not None
    if streaming:
        assert consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
        delta_cb('Checking the mailbox. ')
    else:
        assert not consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
    interim_cb('Looking for the invite.')
    return surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts


async def finish_owned_stream(runner, surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts):
    queued_before = consumer._queue.qsize()
    tts_before = tts.on_delta.call_count
    delta_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    interim_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() == queued_before
    assert tts.on_delta.call_count == tts_before

"""A delivered private sign-in card owns only its exact Slack turn's reply."""
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

import pytest

from test_clanker_vault import service  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from test_kernel_managed_auth import managed, ORIGIN, remote_result  # noqa: F401
from test_private_link_delivery import delivery  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from gateway.config import Platform, StreamingConfig
from gateway.display_config import resolve_display_setting
from gateway.platforms.event import MessageEvent
from gateway.private_access_response import private_access_response_pending
from gateway.run import GatewayRunner
from gateway.run_turn_runner import TurnRunner
from gateway.session import SessionSource
from gateway.slack_workspace import SlackWorkspaceMembership
from gateway.stream_consumer import StreamConsumerConfig
from gateway.turn_context import TurnContext


def gateway(f):
    # Exercise the production workspace-policy resolver, with only Slack I/O fake.
    membership = object.__new__(SlackWorkspaceMembership)
    membership.vault_service = f.service
    adapter = f.service.policy.adapter
    adapter._workspace_membership = membership
    runner = object.__new__(GatewayRunner)
    runner.adapters = {Platform.SLACK: adapter}
    runner._delivery_adapter_for = MagicMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace())
    runner._should_send_voice_reply = MagicMock(return_value=False)
    runner._send_voice_reply = AsyncMock()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response = AsyncMock()
    return runner


async def final_reply(runner, turn, result=None, *, source=None, event_id=None):
    source = source or turn.source
    event = MessageEvent(turn.message, source=source,
        message_id=event_id or turn.message_id)
    text = "Open the private sign-in message; I'll continue after sign-in."
    value = await runner._hmwa_deliver_turn_response(
        event, source, SimpleNamespace(session_id='auth-task'), 'auth-lane', 1,
        {'completed': True} if result is None else result, [], text, 'footer', False,
    )
    return value, text


def stream_surface(runner, turn, *, streaming):
    adapter = SimpleNamespace(
        SUPPORTS_MESSAGE_EDITING=True, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=4000,
        send=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
        edit_message=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
    )
    runner.config = SimpleNamespace(streaming=StreamingConfig(enabled=streaming, transport='edit'))
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.return_value = adapter
    runner._build_stream_consumer_config = lambda *args, **kwargs: (
        StreamConsumerConfig(edit_interval=.01, buffer_threshold=1, cursor='', transport='edit'), None)
    tts = SimpleNamespace(on_delta=MagicMock())
    ctx = TurnContext(source=turn.source, inbound_message_id=turn.message_id,
        event_message_id=turn.message_id, session_key='auth-lane', user_config={},
        resolve_display_setting=resolve_display_setting, interim_assistant_messages_enabled=True,
        streaming_tts_consumer_holder=[tts], _run_still_current=lambda: True)
    surface = TurnRunner(runner, ctx)
    consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, _ = surface._setup_stream_consumer('slack')
    assert consumer is not None
    if streaming:
        assert consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
        delta_cb('Checking the mailbox. ')
    else:
        assert not consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
    interim_cb('Looking for the invite.')
    return surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts


async def finish_owned_stream(runner, surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts):
    queued_before = consumer._queue.qsize()
    tts_before = tts.on_delta.call_count
    delta_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    interim_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() == queued_before
    assert tts.on_delta.call_count == tts_before
    result = {'completed': True, 'final_response': 'REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE', 'messages': []}
    surface._finish_stream_consumer(result, [], consumer)
    await consumer.run()
    rendered = [call.args[1] for call in adapter.send.call_args_list]
    rendered += [call.kwargs.get('content', '') for call in adapter.edit_message.call_args_list]
    assert rendered and all('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE' not in text for text in rendered)
    before = adapter.edit_message.call_count
    await runner._run_agent_mark_streamed_delivery(result, ctx)
    assert adapter.edit_message.call_count == before
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response = AsyncMock()
    runner._is_intentional_silence = lambda *args: False
    await runner._run_agent_deliver_first_response(ctx, adapter, result, result, None)
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response.assert_not_called()

    # The next event using this same source can stream and finalize normally.
    ctx.inbound_message_id = '1760000000.000002'
    assert not private_access_response_pending(ctx.source, ctx.inbound_message_id)
    delta_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    interim_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() > 0 and tts.on_delta.call_count > tts_before


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_card_owns_exact_current_turn_but_preserves_later_replies(delivery):
    d = delivery; f = d.f
    turn = f.turn()
    runner = gateway(f)
    surfaces = [stream_surface(runner, turn, streaming=enabled) for enabled in (False, True)]
    initial = await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN)
    assert private_access_response_pending(turn.source, turn.message_id)
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.reset_mock()
    value, _ = await final_reply(runner, turn)
    assert value is None
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.assert_not_called()
    runner._should_send_voice_reply.assert_not_called()
    runner._send_voice_reply.assert_not_called()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response.assert_not_called()
    assert d.client.chat_postMessage.await_count == 1
    for args in surfaces:
        await finish_owned_stream(runner, *args)

    # Completing sign-in before the original final is shaped must not duplicate
    # its already-delivered card, and the resumed task must still speak normally.
    remote_result(f, initial['request_id']); f.auth.poll()
    assert (await final_reply(runner, turn))[0] is None
    for event_id in ('1760000000.000002', 'clanker-access-resume-' + initial['request_id']):
        value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn, event_id=event_id)
        assert value == text
    other_owner = f.turn('UB')
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, other_owner)
    assert value == text
    other_thread = f.turn(thread='100.9')
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, other_thread)
    assert value == text
    assert d.client.chat_postMessage.await_count == 1
    # An explicit authenticated tool result releases the original turn so useful
    # continued work in that same event can be delivered, despite its card receipt.
    assert (await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN))['status'] == 'authenticated'
    assert not private_access_response_pending(turn.source, turn.message_id)
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn)
    assert value == text


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.parametrize('guard', [
    'failed', 'error', 'interrupted', 'partial', 'incomplete', 'invited',
    'shared', 'other_platform', 'unconfigured',
])
async def test_private_card_never_hides_failures_or_another_delivery_context(delivery, guard):
    d = delivery; f = d.f
    turn = f.turn()
    initial = await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN)
    result = {'completed': True}
    source = turn.source
    if guard in {'failed', 'interrupted', 'partial'}:
        result[guard] = True
    elif guard == 'error':
        result['error'] = 'The browser task failed after requesting sign-in.'
    elif guard == 'incomplete':
        result['completed'] = False
    elif guard == 'invited':
        remote_result(f, initial['request_id']); f.auth.poll()
        f.service.store.mark_resumed(initial['request_id'])
        grant = f.service.delegations.invite(
            {'team': 'TT', 'owner': 'UA'}, initial['handle'], 'UB')['id']
        turn = f.turn('UB')
        await f.auth.authenticate(turn, handle=grant)
        source = turn.source
    elif guard == 'shared':
        source = SessionSource(Platform.SLACK, 'CSHARED', user_id='UA',
            scope_id='TT', profile='UA', thread_id=turn.source.thread_id,
            chat_type='channel')
    elif guard == 'other_platform':
        source = SessionSource(Platform.TELEGRAM, turn.source.chat_id,
            user_id='UA', scope_id='TT', profile='UA', thread_id=turn.source.thread_id)
    runner = gateway(f)
    if guard == 'unconfigured':
        runner.adapters = {}
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn, result, source=source)
    assert value == text
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.assert_called_once_with(source)

from dataclasses import dataclass
import logging

from gateway.config import Platform

logger = logging.getLogger("gateway.run")


def _source_key(source):
    return tuple(getattr(source, key, None) for key in
                 ('platform', 'scope_id', 'user_id', 'chat_id', 'thread_id', 'profile'))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PrivateAccessResponse:
    event_id: str
    source_key: tuple
    pending: bool = True


def mark_private_access_response(source, event_id):
    """Latch only after the backend confirms its committed current-turn card.

    The typed receipt stays process-local; source serialization cannot create it.
    Delta callbacks can check it without querying storage for each token.
    """
    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source))


def private_access_response_pending(source, event_id):
    receipt = getattr(source, '_private_access_response', None)
    return (isinstance(receipt, _PrivateAccessResponse) and receipt.event_id == event_id
            and receipt.source_key == _source_key(source) and receipt.pending)


def release_private_access_response(source, event_id):
    """An explicit authenticated result lets this exact turn continue normally."""
    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source), False)


def private_access_response_successful(agent_result):
    return (not any(agent_result.get(key) for key in ('failed', 'error', 'interrupted', 'partial'))
            and agent_result.get('completed') is not False)


def private_access_response_owned(runner, event, source, agent_result):
    """Suppress ordinary delivery only when the configured backend owns this reply."""
    if (source.platform != Platform.SLACK or source.chat_type not in {'dm', 'private'}
            or source.is_bot or not private_access_response_successful(agent_result)):
        return False
    receipt = getattr(source, '_private_access_response', None)
    if (isinstance(receipt, _PrivateAccessResponse) and receipt.event_id == event.message_id
            and receipt.source_key == _source_key(source) and not receipt.pending):
        return False
    from gateway.slack_workspace import workspace_policy

    policy = workspace_policy(runner, source)
    service = getattr(policy, 'vault_service', None)
    owns_reply = getattr(service, 'private_link_response_owned', None)
    if not callable(owns_reply):
        return False
    try:
        return owns_reply(source, event.message_id) is True
    except Exception:
        # Storage or routing uncertainty cannot justify hiding an ordinary reply.
        logger.warning("Private access response ownership could not be confirmed")
        return False

"""A delivered private sign-in card owns only its exact Slack turn's reply."""
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

import pytest

from test_clanker_vault import service  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from test_kernel_managed_auth import managed, ORIGIN, remote_result  # noqa: F401
from test_private_link_delivery import delivery  # noqa: F401 - fixture dependency
from gateway.config import Platform, StreamingConfig
from gateway.display_config import resolve_display_setting
from gateway.platforms.event import MessageEvent
from gateway.private_access_response import private_access_response_pending
from gateway.run import GatewayRunner
from gateway.run_turn_runner import TurnRunner
from gateway.session import SessionSource
from gateway.slack_workspace import SlackWorkspaceMembership
from gateway.stream_consumer import StreamConsumerConfig
from gateway.turn_context import TurnContext


def gateway(f):
    # Exercise the production workspace-policy resolver, with only Slack I/O fake.
    membership = object.__new__(SlackWorkspaceMembership)
    membership.vault_service = f.service
    adapter = f.service.policy.adapter
    adapter._workspace_membership = membership
    runner = object.__new__(GatewayRunner)
    runner.adapters = {Platform.SLACK: adapter}
    runner._delivery_adapter_for = MagicMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace())
    runner._should_send_voice_reply = MagicMock(return_value=False)
    runner._send_voice_reply = AsyncMock()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response = AsyncMock()
    return runner


async def final_reply(runner, turn, result=None, *, source=None, event_id=None):
    source = source or turn.source
    event = MessageEvent(turn.message, source=source,
        message_id=event_id or turn.message_id)
    text = "Open the private sign-in message; I'll continue after sign-in."
    value = await runner._hmwa_deliver_turn_response(
        event, source, SimpleNamespace(session_id='auth-task'), 'auth-lane', 1,
        {'completed': True} if result is None else result, [], text, 'footer', False,
    )
    return value, text


def stream_surface(runner, turn, *, streaming):
    adapter = SimpleNamespace(
        SUPPORTS_MESSAGE_EDITING=True, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=4000,
        send=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
        edit_message=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
    )
    runner.config = SimpleNamespace(streaming=StreamingConfig(enabled=streaming, transport='edit'))
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.return_value = adapter
    runner._build_stream_consumer_config = lambda *args, **kwargs: (
        StreamConsumerConfig(edit_interval=.01, buffer_threshold=1, cursor='', transport='edit'), None)
    tts = SimpleNamespace(on_delta=MagicMock())
    ctx = TurnContext(source=turn.source, inbound_message_id=turn.message_id,
        event_message_id=turn.message_id, session_key='auth-lane', user_config={},
        resolve_display_setting=resolve_display_setting, interim_assistant_messages_enabled=True,
        streaming_tts_consumer_holder=[tts], _run_still_current=lambda: True)
    surface = TurnRunner(runner, ctx)
    consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, _ = surface._setup_stream_consumer('slack')
    assert consumer is not None
    if streaming:
        assert consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
        delta_cb('Checking the mailbox. ')
    else:
        assert not consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
    interim_cb('Looking for the invite.')
    return surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts


async def finish_owned_stream(runner, surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts):
    queued_before = consumer._queue.qsize()
    tts_before = tts.on_delta.call_count
    delta_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    interim_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() == queued_before
    assert tts.on_delta.call_count == tts_before
    result = {'completed': True, 'final_response': 'REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE', 'messages': []}
    surface._finish_stream_consumer(result, [], consumer)
    await consumer.run()
    rendered = [call.args[1] for call in adapter.send.call_args_list]
    rendered += [call.kwargs.get('content', '') for call in adapter.edit_message.call_args_list]
    assert rendered and all('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE' not in text for text in rendered)
    before = adapter.edit_message.call_count
    await runner._run_agent_mark_streamed_delivery(result, ctx)
    assert adapter.edit_message.call_count == before
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response = AsyncMock()
    runner._is_intentional_silence = lambda *args: False
    await runner._run_agent_deliver_first_response(ctx, adapter, result, result, None)
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response.assert_not_called()

    # The next event using this same source can stream and finalize normally.
    ctx.inbound_message_id = '1760000000.000002'
    assert not private_access_response_pending(ctx.source, ctx.inbound_message_id)
    delta_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    interim_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() > 0 and tts.on_delta.call_count > tts_before


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_card_owns_exact_current_turn_but_preserves_later_replies(delivery):
    d = delivery; f = d.f
    turn = f.turn()
    runner = gateway(f)
    surfaces = [stream_surface(runner, turn, streaming=enabled) for enabled in (False, True)]
    initial = await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN)
    assert private_access_response_pending(turn.source, turn.message_id)
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.reset_mock()
    value, _ = await final_reply(runner, turn)
    assert value is None
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.assert_not_called()
    runner._should_send_voice_reply.assert_not_called()
    runner._send_voice_reply.assert_not_called()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response.assert_not_called()
    assert d.client.chat_postMessage.await_count == 1
    for args in surfaces:
        await finish_owned_stream(runner, *args)

    # Completing sign-in before the original final is shaped must not duplicate
    # its already-delivered card, and the resumed task must still speak normally.
    remote_result(f, initial['request_id']); f.auth.poll()
    assert (await final_reply(runner, turn))[0] is None
    for event_id in ('1760000000.000002', 'clanker-access-resume-' + initial['request_id']):
        value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn, event_id=event_id)
        assert value == text
    other_owner = f.turn('UB')
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, other_owner)
    assert value == text
    other_thread = f.turn(thread='100.9')
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, other_thread)
    assert value == text
    assert d.client.chat_postMessage.await_count == 1
    # An explicit authenticated tool result releases the original turn so useful
    # continued work in that same event can be delivered, despite its card receipt.
    assert (await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN))['status'] == 'authenticated'
    assert not private_access_response_pending(turn.source, turn.message_id)
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn)
    assert value == text

@pytest.mark.parametrize('guard', [

async def test_private_card_never_hides_failures_or_another_delivery_context(delivery, guard):
    d = delivery; f = d.f
    turn = f.turn()
    initial = await f.auth.authenticate(turn, origin=ORIGIN)
    result = {'completed': True}
    source = turn.source
    if guard in {'failed', 'interrupted', 'partial'}:
        result[guard] = True
    elif guard == 'error':
        result['error'] = 'The browser task failed after requesting sign-in.'
    elif guard == 'incomplete':
        result['completed'] = False
    elif guard == 'invited':
        remote_result(f, initial['request_id']); f.auth.poll()
        f.service.store.mark_resumed(initial['request_id'])
        grant = f.service.delegations.invite(
            {'team': 'TT', 'owner': 'UA'}, initial['handle'], 'UB')['id']
        turn = f.turn('UB')
        await f.auth.authenticate(turn, handle=grant)
        source = turn.source
    elif guard == 'shared':
        source = SessionSource(Platform.SLACK, 'CSHARED', user_id='UA',
            scope_id='TT', profile='UA', thread_id=turn.source.thread_id,
            chat_type='channel')
    elif guard == 'other_platform':
        source = SessionSource(Platform.TELEGRAM, turn.source.chat_id,
            user_id='UA', scope_id='TT', profile='UA', thread_id=turn.source.thread_id)
    runner = gateway(f)
    if guard == 'unconfigured':
        runner.adapters = {}
    value, text = await final_reply(runner, turn, result, source=source)
    assert value == text
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.assert_called_once_with(source)

+"""Backend-confirmed private access cards own their current Slack turn's reply."""
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+import logging
+
+from gateway.config import Platform
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("gateway.run")
+
+
+def _source_key(source):
+    return tuple(getattr(source, key, None) for key in
+                 ('platform', 'scope_id', 'user_id', 'chat_id', 'thread_id', 'profile'))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _PrivateAccessResponse:
+    event_id: str
+    source_key: tuple
+    pending: bool = True
+
+
+def mark_private_access_response(source, event_id):
+    """Latch only after the backend confirms its committed current-turn card.
+
+    The typed receipt stays process-local; source serialization cannot create it.
+    Delta callbacks can check it without querying storage for each token.
+    """
+    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source))
+
+
+def _current_receipt(source, event_id):
+    receipt = getattr(source, '_private_access_response', None)
+    if (isinstance(event_id, str) and event_id and isinstance(receipt, _PrivateAccessResponse)
+            and receipt.event_id == event_id and receipt.source_key == _source_key(source)):
+        return receipt
+    return None
+
+
+def private_access_response_pending(source, event_id):
+    receipt = _current_receipt(source, event_id)
+    return receipt is not None and receipt.pending
+
+
+def release_private_access_response(source, event_id):
+    """An explicit authenticated result lets this exact turn continue normally."""
+    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source), False)
+
+
+def private_access_response_successful(agent_result):
+    return (not any(agent_result.get(key) for key in ('failed', 'error', 'interrupted', 'partial'))
+            and agent_result.get('completed') is not False)
+
+
+def private_access_response_owned(runner, event, source, agent_result):
+    """Suppress ordinary delivery only when the configured backend owns this reply."""
+    if (source.platform != Platform.SLACK or source.chat_type not in {'dm', 'private'}
+            or source.is_bot or not private_access_response_successful(agent_result)):
+        return False
+    event_id = getattr(event, 'ledger_message_id', None) or event.message_id
+    receipt = _current_receipt(source, event_id)
+    if receipt is not None and not receipt.pending:
+        return False
+    from gateway.slack_workspace import workspace_policy
+
+    policy = workspace_policy(runner, source)
+    service = getattr(policy, 'vault_service', None)
+    owns_reply = getattr(service, 'private_link_response_owned', None)
+    if not callable(owns_reply):
+        return False
+    try:
+        return owns_reply(source, event_id) is True
+    except Exception:
+        # Storage or routing uncertainty cannot justify hiding an ordinary reply.
+        logger.warning("Private access response ownership could not be confirmed")

from types import SimpleNamespace

from test_kernel_managed_auth import managed, ORIGIN, remote_result  # noqa: F401

from gateway.config import Platform, StreamingConfig
from gateway.display_config import resolve_display_setting
from gateway.platforms.event import MessageEvent
from gateway.private_access_response import private_access_response_pending
from gateway.run import GatewayRunner
from gateway.run_turn_runner import TurnRunner
from gateway.session import SessionSource
from gateway.slack_workspace import SlackWorkspaceMembership
from gateway.stream_consumer import StreamConsumerConfig
from gateway.turn_context import TurnContext


def gateway(f):
    # Exercise the production workspace-policy resolver, with only Slack I/O fake.
    membership = object.__new__(SlackWorkspaceMembership)
    membership.vault_service = f.service
    adapter = f.service.policy.adapter
    adapter._workspace_membership = membership
    runner = object.__new__(GatewayRunner)
    runner.adapters = {Platform.SLACK: adapter}
    runner._delivery_adapter_for = MagicMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace())
    runner._should_send_voice_reply = MagicMock(return_value=False)
    runner._send_voice_reply = AsyncMock()
    runner._deliver_media_from_response = AsyncMock()
    return runner


async def final_reply(runner, turn, result=None, *, source=None, event_id=None, terminal_event_id=None):
    source = source or turn.source
    event = MessageEvent(turn.message, source=source,
        message_id=event_id or turn.message_id, ledger_message_id=terminal_event_id)
    text = "Open the private sign-in message; I'll continue after sign-in."
    value = await runner._hmwa_deliver_turn_response(
        event, source, SimpleNamespace(session_id='auth-task'), 'auth-lane', 1,
        {'completed': True} if result is None else result, [], text, 'footer', False,
    )
    return value, text


def stream_surface(runner, turn, *, streaming):
    adapter = SimpleNamespace(
        SUPPORTS_MESSAGE_EDITING=True, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=4000,
        send=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
        edit_message=AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message_id='preview')),
    )
    runner.config = SimpleNamespace(streaming=StreamingConfig(enabled=streaming, transport='edit'))
    runner._delivery_adapter_for.return_value = adapter
    runner._build_stream_consumer_config = lambda *args, **kwargs: (
        StreamConsumerConfig(edit_interval=.01, buffer_threshold=1, cursor='', transport='edit'), None)
    tts = SimpleNamespace(on_delta=MagicMock())
    ctx = TurnContext(source=turn.source, inbound_message_id=turn.message_id,
        event_message_id=turn.message_id, session_key='auth-lane', user_config={},
        resolve_display_setting=resolve_display_setting, interim_assistant_messages_enabled=True,
        streaming_tts_consumer_holder=[tts], _run_still_current=lambda: True)
    surface = TurnRunner(runner, ctx)
    consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, _ = surface._setup_stream_consumer('slack')
    assert consumer is not None
    interim_cb('Looking for the invite.')
    if streaming:
        assert consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
        delta_cb('Checking the mailbox. ')
    else:
        assert not consumer.stream_deltas_enabled
    return surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts


async def finish_owned_stream(runner, surface, consumer, delta_cb, interim_cb, ctx, adapter, tts):
    queued_before = consumer._queue.qsize()
    tts_before = tts.on_delta.call_count
    delta_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    interim_cb('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() == queued_before
    assert tts.on_delta.call_count == tts_before
    result = {'completed': True, 'final_response': 'REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE', 'messages': []}
    surface._finish_stream_consumer(result, [], consumer)
    await consumer.run()
    rendered = [call.kwargs['content'] for call in adapter.send.call_args_list]
    rendered += [call.kwargs.get('content', '') for call in adapter.edit_message.call_args_list]
    assert rendered and all('REPEATED_SIGNIN_NOTICE' not in text for text in rendered)
    before = adapter.edit_message.call_count
    await runner._run_agent_mark_streamed_delivery(result, ctx)
    assert adapter.edit_message.call_count == before
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response = AsyncMock()
    runner._is_intentional_silence = lambda *args: False
    deferred = AsyncMock()
    runner._pop_post_delivery_callback = MagicMock(return_value=deferred)
    await runner._run_agent_deliver_first_response(ctx, adapter, result, result, None)
    runner._deliver_queued_first_response.assert_not_called()
    deferred.assert_awaited_once()

    # The next event using this same source can stream and finalize normally.
    ctx.inbound_message_id = '1760000000.000002'
    assert not private_access_response_pending(ctx.source, ctx.inbound_message_id)
    delta_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    interim_cb('NEXT_EVENT_RESULT')
    assert consumer._queue.qsize() > 0 and tts.on_delta.call_count > tts_before

+++ b/hermes/gateway/private_access_response.py
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+"""Backend-confirmed private access cards own their current Slack turn's reply."""
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+import logging
+
+from gateway.config import Platform
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("gateway.run")
+
+
+def _source_key(source):
+    return tuple(getattr(source, key, None) for key in
+                 ('platform', 'scope_id', 'user_id', 'chat_id', 'thread_id', 'profile'))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _PrivateAccessResponse:
+    event_id: str
+    source_key: tuple
+    pending: bool = True
+
+
+def mark_private_access_response(source, event_id):
+    """Latch only after the backend confirms its committed current-turn card.
+
+    The typed receipt stays process-local; source serialization cannot create it.
+    Delta callbacks can check it without querying storage for each token.
+    """
+    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source))
+
+
+def _current_receipt(source, event_id):
+    receipt = getattr(source, '_private_access_response', None)
+    if (isinstance(event_id, str) and event_id and isinstance(receipt, _PrivateAccessResponse)
+            and receipt.event_id == event_id and receipt.source_key == _source_key(source)):
+        return receipt
+    return None
+
+
+def private_access_response_pending(source, event_id):
+    receipt = _current_receipt(source, event_id)
+    return receipt is not None and receipt.pending
+
+
+def release_private_access_response(source, event_id):
+    """An explicit authenticated result lets this exact turn continue normally."""
+    source._private_access_response = _PrivateAccessResponse(event_id, _source_key(source), False)
+
+
+def private_access_response_successful(agent_result):
+    return (not any(agent_result.get(key) for key in ('failed', 'error', 'interrupted', 'partial'))
+            and agent_result.get('completed') is not False)
+
+
+def private_access_response_owned(runner, event, source, agent_result):
+    """Suppress ordinary delivery only when the configured backend owns this reply."""
+    if (source.platform != Platform.SLACK or source.chat_type not in {'dm', 'private'}
+            or source.is_bot or not private_access_response_successful(agent_result)):
+        return False
+    event_id = getattr(event, 'ledger_message_id', None) or event.message_id
+    receipt = _current_receipt(source, event_id)
+    if receipt is not None and not receipt.pending:
+        return False
+    from gateway.slack_workspace import workspace_policy
+
+    policy = workspace_policy(runner, source)
+    service = getattr(policy, 'vault_service', None)
+    owns_reply = getattr(service, 'private_link_response_owned', None)
+    if not callable(owns_reply):
+        return False
+    try:
+        return owns_reply(source, event_id) is True
+    except Exception:
+        # Storage or routing uncertainty cannot justify hiding an ordinary reply.
+        logger.warning("Private access response ownership could not be confirmed")
+        return False
